analysis: The only change in this PR is one documentation row added to the scheduler configuration table in docs/architecture/inference.md (head line 850). It describes 128-query-block prompt-chunk attention and a fused causal prefill path, with kill switch DARKBLOOM_TTFT_FUSED_CAUSAL_PREFILL=0 and tuning variable DARKBLOOM_CBV2_ATTN_QUERY_BLOCK. No source, config default, authentication, encryption, coordinator contract or deployment setting is changed in the supplied evidence, so no threat-model assumption is invalidated on its own. The row references AttentionV1.swift and PagedLayerCache.swift, which were not supplied. Whether the fused path respects the mask, window, softcap, vision-span and bidirectional-mask exclusions described, and whether it preserves cross-request isolation for prefix-cache reuse (T-041, T-028), is therefore unverified. If the corresponding code changes ship in a separate PR or batch, that code should be reviewed for those properties. The doc row is purely descriptive and gives no security-relevant evidence of regression. The surrounding base text, covering deadlines, MTP and MiMo, is unchanged context.
